wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A

press A

press A                 # loads the save, then the warp

mark llegada

mark r01-entrada        # the first hall (the Graveyard door Din's Fire opened)

wait 2400               # their 3.5 s and the game's 6 s revive
